description: This file implements internal functions for measuring stack consumption using signal handlers on the Abseil debugging library.

methods.name: GetStackConsumption
methods.description: Calculates the stack consumption based on the touched portion of an alternate stack buffer.

methods.name: GetSignalHandlerStackConsumption
methods.description: Measures the stack consumption of a given signal handler function by setting up an alternate stack and signal handlers, then sending signals and analyzing the stack usage.
